numbers.v3.numbersSenders.identity.name: identity
numbers.v3.numbersSenders.identity.description: The Numbers & Senders ID (`commsidentity_identity_...`) or the Phone Number SID (`PN...`).

numbers.v3.numbersSenders.Idempotency-Ke.name: Idempotency-Key
numbers.v3.numbersSenders.Idempotency-Ke.description:
A key you generate, 1-255 characters; a UUID works. Retry with the same key to get the original
operation back instead of starting a new one. Use a new key for each new request.

numbers.v3.numbersSenders.EnablementSumm.description: One Compliance Registration associated with a Numbers & Senders resource.

accountId.description: The Account SID that created the association.

status.description: The association's status, set as the Compliance Registration changes state.

errors.description:
Reserved for errors that block this association. Always empty today. Branch on `status`,
not on the presence of errors.

regulationId.description: The Regulation SID this association satisfies.

dateUpdated.description: When the association was last updated.

numbers.v3.numbersSenders.Operation.description:
A long-running operation. Returned by the GET and, with `status` `PENDING`, on every 202.
Ignore fields you do not recognize; new ones may be added.

operationId.description: The operation ID. Treat it as opaque.

statusUrl.description: The operation's URL. Follow it as returned.

completedAt.description: When the operation reached a final status.

requestType.description: `CREATE` for an association, `DELETE` for a removal.

failedItems.description: Bulk only. Null when not counted.

updatedAt.description: Bulk only. When progress last changed.

result.description: Bulk only. Item counts of a completed operation.

resultId.description: The Compliance Registration ID of a `COMPLETED` association. `null` otherwise.

resultUrl.description: The resource's ComplianceRegistrations URL, set with `resultId`. `null` otherwise.

resultRetentionPeriod.description: Bulk only. ISO 8601 duration, from `createdAt`, that the results stay available.

error.description: Set only when `status` is `FAILED`; `null` otherwise. Branch on `code`; `detail` is for display only.

pointer.description: JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) to the field in the request.

sid.description: A 34 character string that uniquely identifies this HostedNumberOrder.

accountSid.description: A 34 character string that uniquely identifies the account.

incomingPhoneNumberSid.description: A 34 character string that uniquely identifies the [IncomingPhoneNumber](https://www.twilio.com/docs/phone-numbers/api/incomingphonenumber-resource) resource that represents the phone number being hosted.

addressSid.description: A 34 character string that uniquely identifies the Address resource that represents the address of the owner of this phone number.

signingDocumentSid.description: A 34 character string that uniquely identifies the [Authorization Document](https://www.twilio.com/docs/phone-numbers/hosted-numbers/hosted-numbers-api/authorization-document-resource) the user needs to sign.

phoneNumber.description: Phone number to be hosted. This must be in [E.164](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/E.164) format, e.g., +16175551212

capabilities.description: Set of booleans describing the capabilities hosted on Twilio's platform. SMS is currently only supported.

friendlyName.description: A 64 character string that is a human-readable text that describes this resource.

uniqueName.description: Provides a unique and addressable name to be assigned to this HostedNumberOrder, assigned by the developer, to be optionally used in addition to SID.

status.description: Status of this resource. It can hold one of the values: 1. Twilio Processing 2. Received, 3. Pending LOA, 4. Carrier Processing, 5. Completed, 6. Action Required, 7. Failed. See the [HostedNumberOrders Status Values](https://www.twilio.com/docs/phone-numbers/hosted-numbers/hosted-numbers-api/hosted-number-order-resource#status-values) section for more information on each of these statuses.

failureReason.description: A message that explains why a hosted_number_order went to status "action-required"

dateCreated.description: The date this resource was created, given as [GMT RFC 2822](http://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc2822.txt) format.

dateUpdated.description: The date that this resource was updated, given as [GMT RFC 2822](http://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc2822.txt) format.

verificationAttempts.description: The number of attempts made to verify ownership of the phone number that is being hosted.

email.description: Email of the owner of this phone number that is being hosted.

ccEmails.description: A list of emails that LOA document for this HostedNumberOrder will be carbon copied to.

verificationType.description: The type of ownership verification required to move the number to a `verified` state. The verification methods are `phone-call` or `phone-bill`.

verificationDocumentSid.description: A 34 character string that uniquely identifies the Identity Document resource that represents the document for verifying ownership of the number to be hosted.

extension.description: A numerical extension to be used when making the ownership verification call.

callDelay.description: A value between 0-30 specifying the number of seconds to delay initiating the ownership verification call.

verificationCode.description: A verification code provided in the response for a user to enter when they pick up the phone call.

verificationCallSids.description: A list of 34 character strings that are unique identifiers for the calls placed as part of ownership verification.

phoneNumber.description: The number to host in [+E.164](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/E.164) format

smsCapability.description: Used to specify that the SMS capability will be hosted on Twilio's platform.

accountSid.description: This defaults to the AccountSid of the authorization the user is using. This can be provided to specify a subaccount to add the HostedNumberOrder to.

friendlyName.description: A 64 character string that is a human readable text that describes this resource.

uniqueName.description: Optional. Provides a unique and addressable name to be assigned to this HostedNumberOrder, assigned by the developer, to be optionally used in addition to SID.

ccEmails.description: Optional. A list of emails that the LOA document for this HostedNumberOrder will be carbon copied to.

smsUrl.description: The URL that Twilio should request when somebody sends an SMS to the phone number. This will be copied onto the IncomingPhoneNumber resource.

smsMethod.description: The HTTP method that should be used to request the SmsUrl. Must be either `GET` or `POST`.  This will be copied onto the IncomingPhoneNumber resource.

smsFallbackUrl.description: A URL that Twilio will request if an error occurs requesting or executing the TwiML defined by SmsUrl. This will be copied onto the IncomingPhoneNumber resource.

smsFallbackMethod.description: The HTTP method that should be used to request the SmsFallbackUrl. Must be either `GET` or `POST`. This will be copied onto the IncomingPhoneNumber resource.

statusCallbackUrl.description: Optional. The Status Callback URL attached to the IncomingPhoneNumber resource.

statusCallbackMethod.description: Optional. The Status Callback Method attached to the IncomingPhoneNumber resource.

smsApplicationSid.description: Optional. The 34 character sid of the application Twilio should use to handle SMS messages sent to this number. If a `SmsApplicationSid` is present, Twilio will ignore all of the SMS urls above and use those set on the application.

addressSid.description: Optional. A 34 character string that uniquely identifies the Address resource that represents the address of the owner of this phone number.

email.description: Optional. Email of the owner of this phone number that is being hosted.

verificationType.description: Optional. The method used for verifying ownership of the number to be hosted. One of phone-call (default) or phone-bill.

verificationDocumentSid.description: Optional. The unique sid identifier of the Identity Document that represents the document for verifying ownership of the number to be hosted. Required when VerificationType is phone-bill.

numbers.v3.numbersSenders.OperationAccep.description: Accepted. The body is the operation with `status` `PENDING`.

Location.description: The operation's URL. Equals `statusUrl` in the body. Treat it as opaque.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before the first poll of `statusUrl`.

Access-Control-Allow-Methods.description: Specify the HTTP methods allowed when accessing the resource

Access-Control-Allow-Headers.description: Specify the headers allowed when accessing the resource

Access-Control-Allow-Credentials.description: Indicates whether the browser should include credentials

numbers.v3.numbersSenders.Error-400.description: The body or registration ID is malformed, or the Idempotency-Key header is missing.

schema.description:
The error response from a Twilio service, compliant with RFC-9457 (Problem Details for HTTP APIs).
See https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9457.html for the specification.

type.description:
A URI reference (RFC3986) that identifies the problem type. This URI should resolve to
human-readable documentation for the problem type. When dereferenced, it SHOULD provide
human-readable documentation for the problem type (e.g., using HTML).
For Twilio errors, this should be a URL to https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/{code}

title.description:
A short, human-readable summary of the problem type. It SHOULD NOT change from occurrence
to occurrence of the problem, except for purposes of localization.

status.description:
The HTTP status code generated by the origin server for this occurrence of the problem.
This is the same as the HTTP status code returned in the response.

detail.description:
A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem. This field's value
can change between different occurrences of the same problem type to provide specific details.
detail.example: The 'PhoneNumber' parameter is required but was not provided.

instance.description:
A URI reference that identifies the specific occurrence of the problem. It may or may not
yield further information if dereferenced. This can be used for correlation and debugging.

code.description:
Twilio-specific error code (extension member). This numeric code uniquely identifies
the error type within Twilio's error taxonomy and can be used for programmatic handling.
Registered at https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors

errors.description:
Twilio-specific extension for validation errors (typically HTTP 400/422).
Contains an array of individual field-level validation errors, each with a
human-readable detail message and a JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) indicating the
location of the error in the request. This is particularly useful for
request validation failures where multiple fields may have errors.

detail.description: A human-readable explanation of the validation error for this specific field.

pointer.description: A JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) to the location in the request where the error occurred.
